question: How many times can plastic be recycled, compared with paper?
answer: Every time paper is pulped, its fibres get weaker. After about 7 rounds they lose their strength and end up as processing waste. Plastic can go round at least 20 times.
move: Paper wears out after about 7 recyclings; plastic lasts at least 20.
